decision: Selected the centroid of Maricopa County Assessor parcel 304-04-984A (owner of record C1-MESA LLC, situs 3255 S 96th St, Mesa), the parcel cited by every City of Mesa permit for the CyrusOne Mesa / PHX20 development and the parcel that contains the city's permit geocode for 3255 S 96th St, as the campus locator.

selected_properties.spatial_reference: outSR=4326 (WGS84) as returned by the assessor's ArcGIS MapServer

computed.method: Single-ring polygon returned by the assessor service in WGS84; centroid computed in EPSG:32612 (WGS 84 / UTM zone 12N) and returned to WGS84; geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid

identity_bridge: City of Mesa Building Permits (dzpk-hxfb): every permit at 3255 S 96TH ST cites parcel 30404984A (one trailer permit cites 30404984) and carries the city geocode (-111.626844, 33.356079); the titles are 'CyrusOne Mesa -Shell Building 1' (PMT25-13240), 'CyrusOne Mesa - Shell Build Out' (PMT25-22845), 'PHASE 1 IMPROVEMENT PLANS FOR CYRUSONE - MESA ERTC - Civil Improvements' (PMT25-11012), 'TEMP CONSTRUCTION TRAILER - CYRUSONE MESA - SHELL BUILDING 1' (PMT26-01442), 'TEMP CONSTRUCTION TRAILERS - CYRUSONE MESA' (PMT26-03863), 'CyrusOne Mesa Bldg 1 - PHX20' (PMT26-13840) and 'EXPEDITE- CyrusOne Mesa Building 1 Phase 2' (PMT26-17452).
A point-in-polygon query of the assessor parcel layer at that geocode returns only parcel 304-04-984A, whose situs address is 3255 S 96TH ST, MESA 85212, matching the permit address exactly.

The assessor names C1-MESA LLC (Dallas, Texas mailing address) as owner of record (deed 20180370759, 15 May 2018). An owner query for 'C1-%', 'CYRUSONE%' and 'CYRUS ONE%' returns only this parcel and a CyrusOne TRS Inc parcel in Chandler (303-36-270, also with a Dallas mailing address); the C1 = CyrusOne link is inferred from the name, the shared Dallas mailing city and the CyrusOne-titled permits on the parcel.
unresolved: The position of Shell Building 1 within the 66.5-acre parcel is not published; the centroid locates the CyrusOne property, not the building footprint or the extent of the works.
The assessor publishes no positional accuracy for parcel polygons.
nearby_records: Within 2 km of the centroid: the imported EdgeCore Mesa campus point (imported:semiconductor-atlas:edgecore-mesa, approximate site locator at 3856 S Everton Terr; 1.32 km), the NTT Global Data Centers Phoenix (Mesa) campus proposed in the same fragment (parcel 304-01-006N centroid, 1.09 km; a separate parcel, owner and operator), the held AWS PHX066 parcel at 10437 E Elliot Rd (1.64 km) and the us-southwest-p2 NTT claim point (1.01 km). Meta's 3841 S Ellsworth Rd permit geocode is about 1.5 km south-west. None names CyrusOne, 3255 S 96th St or parcel 304-04-984A.
